verdict.rationale: Several evidence items come from the public GitHub repository github.com/google/adk-python, including a 'contributing/samples' directory, so the framework's source appears readable. Nothing in the pack names the license, so the 'open license' half of the story is unverified. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement (e.g., Apache-2.0), a confirmed LICENSE file, and evidence that the source for the other language SDKs is public.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Code-First Development: Define agent logic, tools, and orchestration directly in Python for ultimate flexibility, testability, and versioning.
